name: The alert that keeps coming back

steps.about: The number is the argument. Nobody prioritises "it fires a lot".
steps.title: Count how many times this month

steps.about: If the answer is the same three commands, that is the fix and it is not the alert.
steps.title: Say what you do each time

steps.about: Three doors and they are all better than the fourth one, which is to keep answering it.
steps.title: Decide: automate, retune, or delete

steps.about: Not on the backlog. It comes back before the backlog does.
steps.title: Do the one you chose now
